========== ========== ========== ==========
  FlashAir RTC SET Tool  v0.07
========== ========== ========== ==========

【 Software Name 】FlashAir RTC SET Tool
【 Author 】Yuukun
【 Operating System 】MSX-DOS2
【 Version 】0.07
【 Last Update 】2021/09/09
【 File Name 】FA_TIME.COM

【 Website 】https://miyako.asablo.jp/blog

---------- ----------
◇ Overview ◇
Utilizes the Wifi function of FlashAir to obtain time from an NTP server (ntp-a1.nict.go.jp)
and sets the RTC of FlashAir and the time of MSX.
Compatible with 1chipMSX, pseudo-SDisk, or devices compatible with MEGASD.

◇ Operating Conditions ◇
1chipMSX (1chipNextorMSX, etc.) or pseudo-SDisk that can use SDHC & FlashAir W-03, W-04
W-04 needs firmware 4.00.01 or later.

◇ Usage ◇
Set FlashAir in the SD card slot of the device and execute this program from MSX-DOS2 or NEXTOR.
Automatically obtains time from the NTP server and sets the time of MSX.

FlashAir must be able to connect to the internet in ST mode, etc.


The following options are available:

/T[+-]xx  Specifies the time zone. The default is /T-09 (Japan Standard Time).
/Sxx      Specifies the slot where the SD card is connected. The default is slot 1.
          If using pseudo-SDisk, specify the slot as /S01, /S02, etc.
          For 1ChipMSX's SD card slot, use /S8B.
/2        Specifies the use of the second SD card slot on pseudo-SDisk.
/W        Does not wait if FlashAir is not connected to Wifi.
/M        Sets only the RTC of FlashAir, does not set the clock of MSX.

◇ Disclaimer ◇
We are not responsible for any damage or loss
caused by the use of this software.
Use at your own risk.

◇ FAQ & Known Bugs ◇
MegaFlashROM SCC+ SD should be usable with an SD-MicroSD reverse conversion adapter
but unconfirmed due to lack of MegaFlashROM SCC+ SD.
NICT plans to stop time distribution via http on March 31, 2022.
So future functionality of this software is uncertain...
